integrity: Proof-based finite-field theorem. Small exhaustive tests are corroboration only and not a universal certificate.
scientific_limitations: Finite abelian p-group algebras in matching characteristic only; neither full conjugacy classification nor nonabelian generalization. Earlier general socle bound is acknowledged. Full publication-priority determination and independent audit not performed.
title: Parabolic automorphism counts and exact socle characters for modular abelian group algebras
